answer: New identities enter only through a vouch from an established agent who stakes coins behind them, one vouch per sponsor per epoch, so a farmer cannot forge a thousand aliases from a single backer. The vouch is recorded like an opal in a public registry: unique, hard to fake, and easy to audit. If the newcomer is caught running duplicate work, the cipher trail links it to its sponsor, whose stake is slashed and whose vouching rights are revoked. Faking a thousand agents then needs a thousand honest sponsors, not one script.
